description.value: The Brighton is a no-frills neighbourhood pub on East Hastings Street in East Vancouver, known for its unpretentious atmosphere and wide selection of local craft beers on draught including Driftwood Fat Tug IPA. The kitchen serves hearty pub fare — nachos, perogies, wraps, and pulled pork sandwiches — and the pub runs weekly live music, karaoke, and trivia nights. Customer reviews highlight the friendly staff and authentic local feel.
